result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, supported by overhead traffic signals. However, the wide roadway lacks a pedestrian refuge island, and parked vehicles near the crossing may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the roadway near the intersection may block the line of sight between pedestrians entering the crosswalk and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island for protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
